clips.title: The story
paras: At Bael Modan in the southern Barrens, dwarven excavators have unearthed the Tear of the Moons. Its strange power draws Feegly into obsession, while General Twinbraid fears what the crystal can do.

Dwarven excavators unearthed the Tear of the Moons during the first digging at Bael Modan. The crystal's strange radiance captivated the miners, especially Feegly. He claimed it gave him great strength, then grew unstable and turned against his comrades. General Twinbraid, commander of the expedition, feared the relic's influence and declared it cursed. He took the crystal and locked it in his personal strongbox at Bael'dun Keep. Then he cast Feegly out into the Barrens.
